subject: Missed walkthrough — three short recovery paths for LumenOps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia@lumenops.com>
Date: 2028-06-25T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome — quick demo scheduled for Tue, Jun 29

Hi Amelia,

Thanks for signing up and taking Redwood for a spin — I scheduled a live walkthrough with our team for Tue, Jun 29 at 10:00 AM PT based on the times you selected.

If that slot still works, no action needed. If you prefer another time, reply with a couple of windows and I’ll move it.

If you want to get a head start, I attached a short one‑pager that highlights the onboarding flow and typical latency/cost wins some customers see after a few days.

Options if the live slot isn’t ideal:
- 15‑minute micro walkthrough with me (quick, focused, ideal for 1–2 people)
- A personalized 5–7 minute screen recording I’ll stitch together after a short discovery note
- A deeper AE demo with architecture/ROI discussion (30–45 min) — I can loop Alex in if helpful

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-onepager.pdf (1 page summary)

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com

-----
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference.
From: Amelia Carter <amelia@lumenops.com>

Date: 2028-06-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo scheduled for Tue, Jun 29

Hi Soojin,

Sorry — I ended up missing the slot this morning. My calendar didn’t sync with a client block.

Would love to see a quick walkthrough. My team is small (just me + one engineer) so a short option is fine. Ideally Thu afternoon (anytime after 2 PM PT). If you have a recorded clip I can watch first, that would help too.

Thanks for understanding —
Amelia Carter
Product Lead, LumenOps
amelia@lumenops.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia@lumenops.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome — quick demo scheduled for Tue, Jun 29

Hi Amelia — no worries at all, thanks for the note.

Quick proposal — three recovery paths so you can pick what fits your week:

1) Microslot (15 minutes) — focused product walk and next steps. I can run this and it’s the fastest route to get you hands‑on. Book here: https://cal.com/soojin/15

2) Personalized async clip (5–7 min) — I record a short walkthrough tailored to your signup flow and usage. I’ll send the recording and a short checklist.

3) AE deep‑dive (30–45 minutes) — architecture, performance characteristics, and cost modeling with Alex. Great if you want infrastructure/ROI discussion.

If you’re a two‑person team, my recommendation is option 1 or 2. I attached a tiny playbook so you can see what each path covers.

Attachments: demo-playbook.pdf, microslot-invite.ics

Alex — looping you in for option 3 if the customer prefers. Tessa, can you monitor and nudge if Amelia doesn’t take a slot by EOD?

Amelia — which do you prefer? If it helps, I tentatively held Thu 4:00 PM PT for a 15‑minute slot; you can accept via the booking link above.

Thanks,
Soojin
